wikitimemachine-desc: Compare a Wikipedia article as it stood on two dates and ask what changed, with permanent revision citations.
wikitimemachine-intro: Pick an article and two moments in time (UTC). You will see the article text as it stood at each moment, what changed between them, and can ask a question answered only from those two revisions.
wikitimemachine-question-placeholder: e.g. How did the article describe the status of Olkiluoto 3?
wikitimemachine-reversed: The first date must not be after the second date.
wikitimemachine-open-revision: Open this exact revision on Wikipedia
wikitimemachine-status-not_covered: No covered snapshot for this time.
wikitimemachine-status-no_revision: The article did not exist yet at this time.
wikitimemachine-status-unavailable: The text of this revision is hidden or unavailable.
wikitimemachine-status-unknown_page: This article has not been ingested.
wikitimemachine-no-change: No differences in the extracted text.
wikitimemachine-same-revision: Both dates resolve to the same revision.
wikitimemachine-gen-disabled: Answer generation is not configured. Showing the retrieved evidence from each revision.
wikitimemachine-gen-unavailable: The answer model is unavailable right now. Showing the retrieved evidence from each revision.
wikitimemachine-gen-rejected: The model's answer failed citation checks and was discarded. Showing the retrieved evidence from each revision.
wikitimemachine-no-support: No supporting passage found in the retrieved evidence.
wikitimemachine-date-only-note: A date without a time means the end of that day (23:59:59 UTC).
wikitimemachine-extracted-note: Extracted text: templates, tables, images and references are omitted. Use the revision links for the complete original.
wikitimemachine-claims-intro: Two kinds of time: the date the office was held (choose below) and the moment Wikipedia said so (the two dates above). Claims are extracted from each revision's infobox and, if configured, by the language model from the prose; every claim keeps its exact source excerpt.
wikitimemachine-claims-none: The article made no claim about who held the office on this date.
wikitimemachine-claims-history: What Wikipedia said about this date over time
wikitimemachine-claims-extractor-llm: extracted from prose by the language model
wikitimemachine-claims-validat-help: Unknown dates are explicit: a tenure whose end is not stated only covers its stated start, and "current" claims are open-ended as of that revision.
wikitimemachine-timeline-help: Select a captured revision, then use it for either comparison date. Green bands show captured history; striped gaps are not covered. The slider steps through saved revisions, not evenly spaced dates.
wikitimemachine-timeline-empty: No captured revisions in this range.
wikitimemachine-timeline-truncated: Showing the first $1 revision intervals. Later intervals are not displayed.
wikitimemachine-timeline-unavailable: This revision has unavailable text. It can be compared, but its text and claims cannot be shown.
wikitimemachine-timeline-no-claims: No published officeholder claim was extracted from this revision.
wikitimemachine-evolution-help: Follow changes to extracted officeholder claims, including names and tenure dates. These are changes in what the article asserted, not independently verified facts. Unchanged revisions are omitted.
wikitimemachine-evolution-boundary: Start of a captured window — changes across the preceding gap are unknown.
wikitimemachine-evolution-initial: Claims in the first captured revision
wikitimemachine-evolution-empty: No changes to published claims in this captured history.
wikitimemachine-evolution-unavailable: Unavailable revision text — changes across this boundary are unknown.
